simple.meaning: זְבוּלֹנִי (Zᵉbûwlônîy) is a Hebrew word meaning “a Zebulonite or descendant of Zebulun.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: זְבוּלֹנִי (H2075) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Numbers 26:27, with occurrences in Numbers, Judges.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to זְבוּלֹנִי (H2075) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in זְבוּלֹנִי (H2075) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: זְבוּלֹנִי (Zᵉbûwlônîy) / H2075 is traced through Numbers 26:27, Judges 12:11, Judges 12:12 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.
